I submitted the dispute for DD-51123 for owner approval. It passed validation on the second try. The first attempt was rejected because the word "applied" contains "lied", so I changed it to "charged".

The dispute cites the ticket listing Veg Momo (Fried) and the ready (18:36) and pickup (18:40) times. It says the ticket doesn't show what was in the bag. I left out the repeat-claimant evidence, because it could read as a comment on the customer.
